name: Anime-zing!
blurb: Three-day anime convention in the Quad Cities with cosplay, concerts, karaoke, tabletop and arcade gaming, and panels.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Anime Convention in Rock Island, IL August 6 - 8, 2027'; location page: 'Anime-zing! will be held at the Holiday Inn in Rock Island, Illinois.'

notes: Corrected place from the batch note's 'Davenport, IA' guess: the con's own site states the venue is the Holiday Inn in Rock Island, Illinois (across the river in the same Quad Cities area, but IL not IA). The /guests and /location pages only show partner-con logos (Anime-ZAP!, AniMinneapolis, 'Midwest' series logos), no actual guest photos for the 2027 edition, so guests is 'none-yet'. Organizer taken as AnimeCon.org, the shared parent brand confirmed on sibling convention Anime Midwest's footer, which lists 'Anime-zing!' among its own family of events.
